entry.name: rnbo_metro
entry.description: Output a bang message at regular intervals. Can be synchronized to an internal or external transport.

arguments.name: interval
arguments.description: Set the metronome interval. When typed as a box argument, this can be either a millisecond value or a Max-style. Sending a number to the right inlet will set a new interval for the metro in milliseconds.
